description: Run the site's public SEO health self-check and return the raw results: sitemap URL count, HTTP status of the key landing pages, llms.txt blog-link liveness, and whether robots.txt still carries the GPTBot and ClaudeBot groups. The server checks its own public pages, so this works from clients whose networks cannot reach printinglabs.com directly. Results are cached for ten minutes; PageSpeed is deliberately not included — call the PageSpeed API separately if you need a performance score.
name: get-seo-health
